facts.note: At nine, when the temple struck, everyone showed watches. Ruedi's was exact, Dr Vauthier's was two minutes ahead, and Girard would not take his out of his pocket.

After dinner she worked beside the master in the atelier. The hall clock struck ten while the regulator showed twelve minutes to ten, and the master made his usual remark about that clock. When the temple struck ten, the regulator agreed with the bell exactly.
He sent her downstairs when the regulator showed twenty past ten. The regulator was running and he was well. She went straight to the kitchen.
That afternoon she saw the master in the kitchen with Rosa's alarm clock in his hands, laughing. She did not ask why.
In the kitchen she read Rosa's clock as the piano began: two minutes to eleven. When the piano stopped it read eleven minutes past eleven.
She stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
